fills.explanation: The spiritual reading anchors "Divine wisdom" and in the Kephalaia's register, the supreme Light is regularly modified by "great" (ⲛⲟϭ); "The great Light of the Father" is a natural Manichaean opening for this primordial cosmological teaching.
The spiritual reading identifies GAP-2 as "the Divine" who discloses wisdom; in the Kephalaia's register, the supreme source of Light is "the Father" (the Father of Greatness).

The spiritual reading says "disclosed to those who receive instruction"; in Kephalaia revelatory discourse, verb pairs for emphasis are standard — "unveiled and revealed to" is the natural parallel construction for the disclosure of divine teaching.
The spiritual reading gives "interior understanding" and the Kephalaia commonly pairs "treasure" with "wisdom" (the entire treasure of wisdom = the whole store of interior knowledge).

fills.explanation: The spiritual reading says "separation of good from evil" followed by "the celestial states"; in the Kephalaia, the primordial separation is always described as "of the Light and the Darkness," and "in the heights" locates it in the celestial realm.

The spiritual reading distinguishes "celestial states" from "inmost heavenly states," and "even" provides the intensifying connector — "the heights even to the heights" — expressing ascent to the innermost degree.

The spiritual reading says "the falsities propagated themselves until they should wage spiritual combat"; in the Manichaean narrative, the powers of Darkness spread upward against the Light boundary until they initiated war — "against the Light" + "unt" completing "until."
The spiritual reading says "wage spiritual combat against the divine dominion," and the standard Kephalaia phrasing is "make war against the kingdom."

The spiritual reading says "the one which no [GAP-17] can be found within it," describing the primordial Light as utterly pure; in the Kephalaia's vocabulary, "darkness" is the opposite quality that cannot be found in the pure Light.
The paragraph transitions from the Light realm to the Darkness realm; "And" is the standard Kephalaia conjunction for introducing the contrasting domain.
The spiritual reading lists "the state of the natural mind" and "their origin" as parallel aspects of Darkness; "and" connects the two descriptors: "the world and their root."

In Manichaean cosmology, the root of Darkness originates from the depths below; "their root below, which poured forth" locates the origin of evil in the lower realm, consistent with the Kephalaia's spatial cosmology.
The spiritual reading shows two consecutive actions of Darkness — "propagated contention" and "threw into disorder" — connected by a simple conjunction.

The spiritual reading says "it threw into disorder" then "rose up"; in the Manichaean narrative, Darkness specifically disturbed the Light aeons before ascending to attack — "the aeons of Light" names the object of disruption consistent with ¶1's description of the heights.
The spiritual reading says "extremity of spiritual need"; in Manichaean cosmogony, when Darkness attacks, the Light realm cries out in great need, prompting the Father to send forth the First Man.
The spiritual reading identifies the source as the Divine from which the Primal Divine-Human proceeds; in Manichaean cosmology, the First Man is sent forth specifically by the Father of Greatness.

The spiritual reading says "the protective truths of divine wisdom"; in the standard Manichaean narrative, the First Man "clothed himself with" the five elements as his armour of Light before descending to battle Darkness.
The spiritual reading indicates the armour of Light was deployed against the fundamental opposition; "against all the enmity" is the standard Kephalaia construction for combat with evil.

The spiritual reading confirms "the essential antagonism between heavenly order and the hells"; in the Kephalaia's register, "the enmity" correctly expresses the fundamental opposition that the First Man subdued.
The spiritual reading transitions from the First Man's combat to the Living Spirit's cosmic construction; "Then" provides the sequential transition standard in Kephalaia cosmological narrative.
In Manichaean cosmology, the sun and moon are always paired as vessels of Light connected to the Light aeons; the spiritual reading confirms both as expressions of divine love and wisdom.

The spiritual reading transitions from the Light aeons to the Living Spirit's establishment of the spiritual order; "And then the" provides the standard sequential conjunction in Kephalaia cosmological exposition.
The spiritual reading lists "the whole spiritual order" and "the external natural" as two things the Living Spirit established; "and" joins "the universe and the earth" in standard Kephalaia pairing.

The spiritual reading says "wisdom and falsity in the first state"; in Manichaean cosmology, the Living Spirit's primary cosmic action is separating Light from Darkness, which is the essential ordering function described here.

The spiritual reading pairs GAP-39 with "the external truths that clothe interior things" (garments); in the Kephalaia, "bodies" and "garments" are a standard cosmological pair denoting inner forms and their outer coverings.

The spiritual reading says "against falsity from evil"; this directly parallels ¶3's "the Darkness has made war against the Light" — now the cosmic structures in the heights wage the reverse war against the powers of the Darkness.
The spiritual reading says "established immovably," and "was fixed" (f + ixed) completes the partial word while expressing the firmness of divine establishment after "He stood firm."
The spiritual reading says "He laid the fundamental truths and the whole of it was set in order"; "and" provides the natural conjunction between the foundation and the completed arrangement.

The spiritual reading says "three degrees of the natural mind"; the Living Spirit constructs cosmic structures, and the three conjoined earths are a standard feature of Manichaean cosmology built by the Living Spirit alongside the heavens.
The partial word gap completes "four" (f + our); the spiritual reading says "within four elevated states," and the article "the" naturally precedes the numeral in Kephalaia cosmological description.

The spiritual reading says "within its general knowledges and its elevated states," indicating the vessels are located within the seas and mountains; "that are" provides the relative clause connecting vessels to their location.
The spiritual reading says "arranged upon it," corresponding to "set in order upon it"; "all was" provides the subject for the passive construction preceding the partially visible "set in."
The spiritual reading says "stood firm as a restraint"; "as" connects "stood firm" to "a bond for the evil powers," indicating the universe's function as a cosmic prison.
The spiritual reading says "wisdom that had become commingled with falsity"; the universe is a bond both for the evil powers AND for the light (li + ght) mixed with Darkness, awaiting separation.
The spiritual reading confirms the Third Ambassador's role as separating and purifying commingled wisdom; "He purified the Light" accurately captures this action in the Kephalaia's natural register.

The spiritual reading says "the one who redeems, liberates from bondage to falsity"; "redeemer of" correctly renders this in the Kephalaia's Christological-soteriological vocabulary for the Third Ambassador's role.
The spiritual reading continues the cosmological exposition; "And" is the standard Kephalaia conjunction introducing a new phase of the narrative about the mixture of Light and Darkness.
The spiritual reading shows a sequence — fire consumes, and then the Light is also affected; "and" provides the conjunction connecting the devouring of evil to the purification of the Light portion.
The spiritual reading refers to "of the wisdom also"; in Manichaean vocabulary, "the portion of the Light" is the standard phrase for the Light particles mixed into matter undergoing purification.

The spiritual reading says the falsity from evil goes "outward"; "it goes out" describes the Darkness being expelled from the mixture during the final separation, a standard Manichaean eschatological motif.

The spiritual reading transitions from the restraint of Darkness to the disclosure of the Light realm; "and they" provides the subject shift from the bound Darkness to the redeemed Light particles who then unveil and enter into the Divine.

The spiritual reading says "the perception of spiritual good"; in Manichaean soteriology, redeemed light particles ascending become "a sweet perfume" (pe + rfume), a standard image for purified spiritual substance.
The spiritual reading says "established"; "they are set up" (s + et up) describes the redeemed light particles being permanently established in the Light realm after becoming perfume.
The spiritual reading says "and they exercise dominion for ever"; the redeemed are set up "in the Light" (their proper domain) before the conjunction "and" (an + d) introduces their eternal reign.

The spiritual reading says "a single Divine comes to be over the whole of creation"; in the Kephalaia's royal vocabulary, God becomes "king over" (ov + er) the totality, echoing the closing reference to "the King of the Light."

The spiritual reading completes a title pair for the Father; in the Kephalaia, "the King of the Light and the aeons of Light" is a well-attested formulaic pairing describing the Father's sovereignty over both the Light and its emanated states.

The spiritual reading says "the states in which they occur"; in the Kephalaia, "aeons" is the standard term for the successive cosmic states or periods in which the mixture of Light and Darkness subsists.

The spiritual reading describes the ongoing fallen state of commingling; "from the beginning until now they are mixed" is a standard Manichaean temporal expression describing the duration of the cosmic mixture from the primordial attack to the present age.

The spiritual reading introduces the content of the first teaching; "is that" provides the standard Kephalaia definitional structure — "The first great lesson is that which..." — identifying the lesson with the cosmic structure described in the relative clause that follows.
The spiritual reading says "on account of the openings of influx disclosed within them"; in Manichaean cosmology, the doors or gates that open are in the firmament, through which light passes upward.
